paper_title: Deepest sensitivity to wavelike dark photon dark matter with superconducting radio frequency cavities
notes: Proof-of-concept dark photon dark matter search using a nontunable 1.3 GHz SRF cavity (QL=4.7e9) at Fermilab SQMS (SERAPH phase 1). Excludes kinetic mixing chi > 1.5e-16 at 90% CL for m_A' = 5.354 ueV (f0 = 1.2946 GHz). The exclusion is extremely narrowband (~few kHz around the cavity frequency, corresponding to ~few peV in mass), so a single (mass, coupling) point is reported at the stated dark photon mass. Assumes standard halo model with rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and random polarization. The gaγγ ~ 3e-16 GeV^-1 axion figure mentioned is hypothetical (would require an 8 T field), not an actual limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 1))
